title: Project State
description: Top-level state for an i2c project. Read on every worker invocation; written at state transitions and phase boundaries. Lives at .state/project.json.

phase.description: Current phase number. 0 means project not yet started.

state.description: Current lifecycle position. plan|execute|review|close dispatch the matching ACTION. audit_boundary (post-CLOSE, human/wrapper decides advance vs. done) and audit_escalation (mid-phase escalation, human required) both EXIT. done is terminal — no further dispatch unless an operator explicitly sets state=plan with a new phase. See DESIGN_state_lifecycle_v1.md (D-state-1..7) for the full model.

steps_remaining.description: Step budget remaining for the current invocation. Reserved for multi-step mode (Phase 3.C).

gotchas.description: Short operational reminders learned at phase close. Read on every worker invocation. Promoted from devlog learnings.

budget_type.description: Active phase's budget mode. 'steps' uses steps_remaining (Build regime); 'time' uses time_budget_seconds + time_started_at (Refine regime). Inferred from the current phase's regime when omitted.

time_budget_seconds.description: Total wall-clock budget for the current phase in seconds. Used when budget_type='time' (Refine regime). The state machine compares (now - time_started_at) against this value.

time_started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current time-budgeted phase started. Set when transitioning to execute under Refine regime; cleared at phase close.
